identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit: 'Girlventures' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-3319189); the same EIN is shown on girlventures.org
Organization's own website lists a mailing address in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda text 'Oakland, CA'
Website describes youth programs (outdoor education and leadership for girls and gender-expansive youth), consistent with OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' contract
research.notes: Confidence is medium, not high: ProPublica (IRS record) describes the organization as San Francisco-based, while the organization's own website gives an Oakland address (the IRS address may be out of date). Neither page mentions Oakland Unified / OUSD directly. Web search budget was exhausted, so the California Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked.

profile.summary: GirlVentures is a nonprofit that runs outdoor education and leadership programs for girls and gender-expansive youth. Its programs explore identity, social justice, leadership, health and the environment, and aim to build self-esteem and resilience.
